title: Upload verification documents
content_data:
Use this endpoint to upload your verification documents. After successfully uploading your documents, call [/account/verification/submit/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/submit-a-verification-request-for-your-account/v1.3) to officially submit your account verification request. ## Before you begin - Confirm the supported business or personal identification document types for your account by calling [/account/verification/filetype/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/get-available-verification-document-types-for-a-region/v1.3). - Familiarize yourself with common pitfalls by reviewing the [List of common rejection reasons and suggestions for verification failures](https://ads.tiktok.com/help/article/list-of-common-rejection-reasons-and-suggestions-for-verification-failures). ## Request **Endpoint** https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/account/verification/upload/ **Header** ```xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |Access-Token {Required}|string|Authorized access token. For details, see [Authentication](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/marketing-api-authentication/v1.3).| |Content-Type {Required}|string|Request message type.

Allowed value: `multipart/form-data`.| ``` **Parameters** ```xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |image_file1 {Required}|file|A verification document.
You can specify either a business verification document or a personal identification document.

For a personal identification verification request which usually requires two images (front and back), you can provide the front image via `image_file1` and the back image via `image_file2`.

File size: within 10 MB.

Supported formats: JPEG, PNG, and JPG.| |image_file2|file|An additional verification document.
You can specify either a business verification document or a personal identification document.

For a personal identification verification request which usually requires two images (front and back), you can provide the front image via `image_file1` and the back image via `image_file2`.

File size: within 10 MB.

Supported formats: JPEG, PNG, and JPG.| ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location --request POST 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/account/verification/upload/' \ --header 'Access-Token: {{Access-Token}}' \ --header 'Content-Type: multipart/form-data' \ --form 'image_file1=@"{{image_file1}}"' (/code) ``` ## Response ```xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |-|-|-| |code |number|Response code. For the complete list of response codes and descriptions, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/return-codes-appendix/v1.3).| |message |string|Response message. For details, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/return-codes-appendix/v1.3).| |request_id|string| The log ID of the request, which uniquely identifies a request.| |data|object|Returned data.| #|qualification_image_ids|string[]|A list of qualification image IDs.

The number of IDs can be 1 or 2, depending on the total number of files you uploaded.| ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code curl http) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "{{request_id}}", "data": { "qualification_image_ids": [ "{{qualification_image_id}}" ] } } (/code) ```
